vibe: Warm, social, inclusive, neighborhood/hobbyist/alumni vibe. Not corporate.

rules: Avoid Inter and Space Grotesk completely.
H1-H2 must have tracking-tight (-0.02em) to tracking-tighter.
Body must have leading-relaxed (1.625) for high readability.
No generic bold for headings; prefer font-medium or font-black to create tension.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped layouts.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-full for friendly vibe. Forms can use rounded-xl.
rules: Asymmetry creates tension. Use organic flows and friendly bento grids.
Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.
Max image height 80vh on mobile to prevent blocking.

components.navbar: Glassmorphism but warm (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-orange-900/10). Sticky top.
components.hero: Soft background, high contrast text, organic rounded shapes or bento grid with warm colors. Image overlay should not exceed bg-black/30 or use a warm gradient overlay.
components.event_cards: Solid background (white) with subtle warm shadow (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(232,106,88,0.1)]). Generous internal padding (p-6). Large rounded corners (rounded-2xl).
components.member_cards: Tactile variant of Neumorphism. Off-white background matching parent (bg-muted/50), 1px border-black/5, soft shadow. Circular avatars.
components.calendar_grid: Clean grid, border-collapse, subtle border-orange-900/10. Highlight today with the primary color (Warm Coral).
components.news_articles: Editorial style. Large images, prominent headings, generous white space. Work Sans for high readability body copy.
components.admin_dashboard: Clean, flat cards, border-border. Dense but friendly. Use Phosphor Icons. Sidebar for navigation. Avoid cold 'corporate SaaS' gray borders.
components.forms: Large, accessible inputs. rounded-xl. focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2. Friendly labels with slight muted color.
components.ai_writer_tool: Use an inline playful UI. Pastel yellow background (bg-secondary/20), sparkling icon (lucide-react 'Sparkles' in Coral), rounded-2xl to feel approachable, not scary.

animation_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have clear hover states (e.g., hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg). Ensure focus states are high contrast.
animation_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease.
animation_and_interactions.loading: Use pulsing elements matching the brand primary or secondary colors, not generic gray spinners.

rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='rsvp-button').
Images must have descriptive alt text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Work Sans'. Setup in tailwind.config.js.
Install @phosphor-icons/react for friendly, rounded iconography (or use lucide-react if already installed).
Replace default Tailwind CSS variables in index.css with the ones provided in this JSON.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or Inter.
Ensure the hero section highlights the vibrant community gathering image provided. Apply a very light overlay so the subjects remain visible.
Build the components emphasizing warmth: generous padding, large rounded corners, and soft, colored shadows.
